free.title: Carnegie Deli Reopens After 10 Years
free.caption:
JUST OPENED · CARNEGIE DELI

New York's most-mourned deli just came back from the dead, and the pastrami stack looks exactly like you remember it.

Carnegie Deli closed in 2016 after almost 80 years on Seventh Avenue. Third-generation owner Sarri Harper reopened the doors on September 15th a few blocks from the original spot, with the same hand-cut pastrami piled nearly six inches high and the Wall of Fame photos back on the walls. It's walk-in only, no reservations, so weekday lunch (noon-2pm) is when the line gets long.

One sandwich easily feeds two or three, so don't over-order, and save room: the cheesecake is $15-16 a slice.

Send this to whoever used to swear by the old location.

📷 Patch NY / Time Out New York

food.title: Levain Bakery Chocolate Chip Walnut Cookie
food.caption:
FOOD · LEVAIN BAKERY

The chocolate chip walnut cookie New Yorkers have lined up for since 1995, still baked six ounces heavy with a molten center.

Levain's Upper West Side basement window on Amsterdam Avenue is the original, and it still sells out the classic same-day, warm from the oven. It's grab-and-go only (no seating), open 7am-10pm daily, and the cookie itself is best eaten within the first 30-45 minutes while the center is still soft. Price runs $4-6 depending on the location and time of day.

Skip delivery apps if you can, the in-store price is noticeably better.

Send this to your favorite cookie person.

📷 Levain Bakery

art.title: Space Explorers: The ISS Experience
art.caption:
ART · SPACE EXPLORERS: THE ISS EXPERIENCE

A free-roaming VR exhibit just landed on West 57th Street that puts you inside a real spacewalk, 250 miles above Earth.

Space Explorers: The ISS Experience uses 360-degree footage actually shot by astronauts on NASA missions, not animation, so you free-roam through a mapped set while the headset shows you the International Space Station around you. It's about 40 minutes, ages 8 and up, Tuesday to Sunday at Eclipso NYC on West 57th. Tickets run from $39 for NY residents, $49 standard.

Book the earliest slot you can, the headset fitting takes a few extra minutes and later sessions run behind.

Send this to whoever still wanted to be an astronaut.

📷 Space Explorers / Eclipso NYC
